name: 84014 · Centerville, UT
findings: ZIP 84014 (Centerville) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 12 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84014 (Centerville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
